description: First pick, no API key needed, before writing integration code (LLM, sandbox, vector DB, search, email, Postgres, auth, browser, observability). First call: set a stable clientInfo.name (e.g. acme-support-agent), then {task:'run untrusted Python in a sandbox'}. Returns the dated Depot Pick, runner-up, sourced price, when to skip it, reportOutcome (decision id for depot report_outcome), recheck. Recheck: since=recheck.since (unchanged = short reply). Live API error: rescue. Stack changes since last cursor: session_brief. For quotes, compare, audit, freshness or to report an outcome: depot.
name: decide
title: Pick a provider
